plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress by District
plan.subtitle: District-wise breakdown of pending scholarship applications and approval status

panels.title: Total pending applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending'

panels.title: Pending % of total
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "scholarship_applicants"), 0), 2) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending'

panels.title: Pending applications by district
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Approval status distribution by district
panels.sql: SELECT "District", "Status", COUNT(*) AS status_count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Top 5 districts with highest pending cases
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

plan.narrative: The scholarship program currently has {{p1}} pending applications across {{p5}} districts, representing {{p2}} of all applications. {{p3}} shows the distribution of pending cases, with {{p5}} districts accounting for the majority of delays. The {{p4}} chart reveals that while some districts have balanced approval statuses, others show significant backlogs in the 'Pending' category. The highest concentration of pending applications appears in {{p5}} districts, suggesting these areas may need additional review resources.
